naslov: AI Wars Ep. 20: Anthropic stock jumps on day one, then safety critics hit
opis:
Anthropic opened on Nasdaq under ANT at $111.50, about a third above its $83 IPO price, after raising $81.3 billion in the largest IPO in history. TechCrunch reports that each of the seven founders cashed out roughly $280 million. The same day, the Center for AI Safety published a statement calling Anthropic "not a safe AI company." Nobel laureates signed it, and early investor Dustin Moskovitz publicly distanced himself.

naslov: CLI-Anything: turn existing programs into CLIs for Claude Code | AI Tool #25
opis:
An open-source project that builds a command-line interface (CLI) for existing programs so agents like Claude Code can use them. It also has a catalog of community-made CLIs.

How to try it:
1. pip install cli-anything-hub
2. cli-hub install <name> for a CLI from the catalog at clianything.cc
3. Tell Claude Code to use that CLI instead of an MCP server (fewer tokens)

Price: free

Official link: https://github.com/HKUDS/CLI-Anything

naslov: PostgreSQL 19 WAIT FOR LSN: read-your-writes on replicas, explained | AI Tool #26
opis:
The new Postgres release brings "read-your-writes": a standby server (replica) can wait until it has received your latest write before answering a query. It shipped two months later than usual because of a wave of AI-discovered vulnerabilities.

How to try it:
1. Run it locally via Docker (official postgres image; check the link to see whether 19 is out yet)
2. After a write, grab the position with SELECT pg_current_wal_insert_lsn();
3. On the replica, run WAIT FOR LSN '<value>' WITH (TIMEOUT '0.1s'); and only then SELECT

Price: free

Official link: https://simonwillison.net/2026/Nov/19/postgresql-19/

naslov: What is AI computer use? Explained in 30 seconds
opis:
Computer use means an AI operates a computer like a person would: it looks at the screen, moves the mouse, clicks and types inside normal apps. This week Google added computer use to the Gemini app for macOS. You choose which apps it can access and watch it work live in a separate window. For now it's English only and US only.
